origin: A real Antigravity CLI 1.1.23 conversation directory, kept in the layout the vendor writes so the parser's own path join is exercised: brain/<uuid>/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl. Redacted by field allowlist. Every field the parser reads is the tool's own -- step_index, source, type, status, created_at, and each tool call's name -- as is truncated_fields, which names fields rather than carrying one. Every field it does not read is replaced: content and thinking become the same number of sentinel lines, and each tool-call argument keeps its schema key and loses its value. The conversation uuid is a stand-in. It is the conversation whose gen_metadata series 23454 -> 30743 -> 38860 -> 41063 settled that the one figure this source keeps is context-window occupancy and not a billable count.
method: Counted by reading the eight transcript entries: seven carry source MODEL and one carries USER_EXPLICIT, and four tool calls are named across them. The seven model entries are four responses, not seven: three of them are written twice over, as a GENERIC entry holding the content and a PLANNER_RESPONSE entry holding the thinking and the tool call, both stamped with the same created_at. No call into internal/parser.

derivations.records: four, one per model response. Seven of the eight entries carry source MODEL, and three pairs of them share a created_at to the second -- entries 2+3, 4+5 and 6+7, each a GENERIC content entry and the PLANNER_RESPONSE entry holding that same response's thinking and tool call. One response written as two entries is one turn; counting the lines would report seven. The eighth entry is the person's prompt and is filtered rather than skipped: it is a valid line carrying no model turn.
derivations.sessions: one -- the conversation directory's name. Nothing inside the transcript identifies it, which is why the parser is handed the id rather than reading one.
derivations.input_tokens: 0, and the whole point of this trace. Antigravity CLI publishes no input counter anywhere under its data root; the depth row answers no token signal, so this zero is a declared absence rather than a measured quantity, and every $ figure withholds its verdict for this source instead of averaging it in.
derivations.output_tokens: 0, same as input: no output counter exists in this format.
derivations.cache_read_tokens: 0: no cache accounting of any kind.
derivations.cache_write_tokens: 0: no cache accounting of any kind.
derivations.cache_write_1h_tokens: 0: no cache accounting of any kind.
derivations.reasoning_tokens: 0. The entries carry a thinking field holding the text itself and no count of it, and counting its characters would be assaio's estimate rather than the vendor's figure.
derivations.lines_added: 0. The write_to_file calls carry the whole new file rather than a diff, so there is no + marker to count and a line count of an overwrite is not an added-line count.
derivations.rework_lines: 0. Rework needs an edit sequence per file; the argument naming the file is content this parser never reads.
derivations.edits: 3 -- the three write_to_file calls, which the shared tool-class allowlist maps to the write class. The fourth call is run_command.
derivations.tool_calls: 4 -- three write_to_file and one run_command, named across four of the seven model turns.
derivations.tool_errors: 0, and deliberately not claimed. The vendor writes ERROR_MESSAGE entries -- 384 across the captured corpus -- but they are stream and platform failures rather than a tool call returning an error, so counting them under tool_errors would answer a different question than the one that signal asks.
derivations.skipped: all eight lines are valid JSON and every model turn carries a readable created_at.
derivations.steps: 0. The transcript is ordered and a step reading is possible in principle, but the captured corpus holds 26 tool calls across 500 conversations, so there is no sequence for a detector to read and the depth row claims none.
derivations.step_targets: 0, for the same reason -- and the file a write names is a tool argument, which is content this parser has no path to.
